title: Card: profile and optimize training hot loops
body:
Roadmap goal-1 remainder: profile and optimize hot loops (informs Rust-kernel deferral decision).

WORKTREE: /home/mana/.cache/slog-hotloop on branch feat/train-perf (base 9871d0c2f). NOT landed to api-std yet (their 29-file staged set has zero overlap with my 9 files — verified via git diff --cached).

PROFILE (gate config, 120 steps, cProfile driver /tmp/opencode/profile_hotloops.py):
- Before: 68.4s at load ~15 / 81.1s at load ~19. Serialization ~46% (save_soul 3 walks); math ~43% (bk 19.7-25.5s, bk_fused 11.2-16.7s, gelu 6.9-7.5s).
- After: 11.77s (6.9x). bk 25.5->0.4s, save_soul 37.5->9.9s, sanitize 15.2->1.5s.

FIXES (all in worktree, 9 files):
1. resource_manager.py: NEW _pin_openblas_threads — pins loaded OpenBLAS via ctypes C API (scipy_openblas_set_num_threads64_ etc; discovery: numpy.libs glob + /proc/self/maps maxsplit=5). Wired into apply_compute_limits (np.set_num_threads is dead on numpy 2.x). Root cause: 8 OpenBLAS threads on 8-core box at load 15-19 sync-thrashed tiny matmuls (16.9-22.5ms vs 10.7ms pinned).
2. domain/training/__init__.py: guarded apply_blas_env + apply_compute_limits at import (train_pipeline.py is in api-std staged set — cannot touch).
3. 3 benchmark scripts: OPENBLAS/OMP setdefault before import numpy.
4. slo_format.py: save_soul single sanitize pass (was 3x); _soul_profile_hash extracted; hash semantics unchanged (gate final 1.33e-05 byte-identical pre/post).
5. benchmark_slonet_training.py: --only + --results chunk flags + per-config flush (was all-or-nothing).
6. train_pipeline.py _gc_parked_step: RSS-growth trigger (SLO_GC_RSS_GROWTH_BYTES, default 2GiB) alongside 50-step interval.

OOM ROOT CAUSE (medium config died oom-kill 18.0G):
- _gc_parked disables cyclic GC whole run (deliberate 2.9->31 steps/s), collects only every 50 steps.
- Autograd graph is cyclic (_consumers/_children/closures) — refcounting never frees it; needs gen-2 GC.
- Garbage scales with model size: medium +0.77GB/step, +244 tensors/step (repro /tmp/opencode/probe_nogc.py) -> ~40GB before first collect -> OOM step ~15. Probe with gc.collect(): flat (106 tensors, 0.05G) — pure GC-timing, no true leak (backward clears _consumers).
- Fix: collect every 50 steps OR RSS delta >= 2GiB since last (baseline = post-collect RSS, self-stabilizing). Repro after: bounded sawtooth peak 3.1G, losses byte-identical.

VERIFICATION:
- RED->GREEN tests: test_worker_resource (2 pin tests), test_slo_format_extended (to_dict exactly once/save; NaN->null guard).
- 176 passed (train_pipeline, convergence, status transitions, long_run_resume); 428 passed / 1 pre-existing failure (test_get_slo_layernorm — LayerNorm absent on clean main too, baseline-543 set); goal12+owned 9 passed; quantization 2/2 (needs PYTHONPATH=.).
